Why Kick was missing before: the original five-file Pre-Alpha bundle has no kick atlas. That does not mean Kick art does not exist. The authentic V3 Spartan Kick, with improved supporting-leg Blender lighting, exists on Graphics 3A draft #825. It is included here as experimental art under visual review, not a claim of Pre-Alpha integration or Main approval.

Knockdown / Fall V2 is the true original Blender pose source from draft #788; the source image here is present unchanged in the parent candidate #825. Unsupported Combat states (light/heavy attacks, parry, block, stun, death) still lack these authored Silver animations and use honest Combat visuals in the game.

Source: original five verified from Pre-Alpha candidate 76aaf055, kick and knockdown from original draft 3fc26bb. All seven files SHA-256 verified before embedding. Walk and sprint playback are sample loops; in the game, those cycles are distance-driven. The gallery is not a playable build, merge, or release declaration.
